name: Canary Islands
terms: Denominación de Origen Calificada, a step above DO for regions with a record of consistent quality. Only Rioja and Priorat hold it.
Denominación de Origen, Spain's main quality tier.
Spain's regional wine tier, below DO.
Vino de Calidad con Indicación Geográfica, a Spanish tier above Vino de la Tierra and below DO.
A wine from a pago, a named rural site with its own soil and microclimate. All its grapes must grow there.
Young wine, sold with little or no aging. Some see a few months in oak.

blurb.text: Spain's island wine group, with appellations on islands such as Lanzarote, La Palma, El Hierro, La Gomera and Gran Canaria, plus Tenerife areas like Abona. Listán de Huelva and Listán Negro lead plantings at 17 percent each, then Malvasia de Lanzarote at 11 and Negramoll at 4.
